steps.en: Install Celery and have Redis or RabbitMQ running as the broker
steps.zh: 装好 Celery，并跑一个 Redis 或 RabbitMQ 作 broker
steps.code: pip install celery · docker run -d -p 6379:6379 redis

steps.en: Create an app in an importable module and mark the slow function as a task
steps.zh: 在可导入模块里建 app，把慢函数标成任务

steps.en: Start worker pools on the machines meant to run the work
steps.zh: 在负责跑任务的机器上启动 worker 池

steps.en: Workers hold an open connection and consume task messages off the broker queue
steps.zh: worker 保持连接，从 broker 队列持续消费任务消息

steps.en: Call the task from your request handler and return immediately
steps.zh: 在请求处理器里调用任务，立刻返回

steps.en: An idle worker picks the job up, executes it, and can store the result in a backend
steps.zh: 空闲 worker 取走执行，并可把结果写进 result backend

value.en: The HTTP response returns in milliseconds while heavy Python work runs on a worker pool that survives restarts and scales across machines
value.zh: HTTP 响应立即返回；重活跑在能扛重启、可跨机扩展的 worker 池上

sources: docs.celeryq.dev/en/stable/getting-started/first-steps-with-celery.html (retrieved 2026-09-28): pip install celery; docker run -d -p 6379:6379 redis; app = Celery('tasks', broker='pyamqp://guest@localhost//') with @app.task def add(x, y); celery -A tasks worker --loglevel=INFO; add.delay(4, 4)
